provenance.purpose: Seed replication of the polarity-balanced run. Identical settings, seed 7 -> 123 for both cell sampling and training.
provenance.cells: 254 per cell x 4 (gold A/B x net +/-)
provenance.sources: PrimeVul time-disjoint train, PatchEval train, DeltaSecommits train (v2, newline-fixed)

provenance.epochs_rationale: 2 epochs on 1016 pairs matches the prose-native pilot 1 epoch on 1736 pairs in optimizer steps (~2032 pair-updates), so the comparison is compute-matched.
